name: prose-check
description: Checks the agent's final reply to the human against the project's writing rules with TypeSafe Jev, and asks for one rewrite when it breaks them.

timeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for TypeSafe Jev before passing the reply through unchecked.

minLength.title: Minimum reply length
minLength.description: Replies with fewer characters than this pass through unchecked.

breachThreshold.title: Breach threshold
breachThreshold.description: Jev's probability, from 0 to 1, at or above which a rule counts as broken.

debug.title: Debug records
debug.description: Writes one JSON line per extraction event and per check to debug.jsonl in the per-user state directory.
